privateTargetConfiguration: Must be supplied outside repository and OneDrive
operations: Create one dedicated lab workspace on an explicitly selected existing capacity, or use an approved isolated workspace
Create one lab-owned managed-Delta lakehouse and load synthetic miniature only
Create complete subscriptions and finance semantic models
Generate one native ontology and add second model through reviewed portal agent action
Read native and GA IQ tool inventories and run bounded synthetic source queries
excluded: Capacity creation, scaling, pause/resume or shared-capacity settings
Tenant setting changes or role/permission grants
App registrations, consent or reader creation without a separate exact approval

teardown.policy: Delete only manifest-owned items after preview/confirmation; never delete/pause shared capacity
